feature: Project Manager project access and commitment write permissions

flows.name: Resolve every supported project access source consistently
steps: Resolve active directory membership, project-role membership, and company-wide template access through the shared resolver
Carry the effective template into the project shell authorization result
Apply the same company-wide access rule to the project portfolio
flows.expectedOutcome: A Project Manager with a project role and company template can see and open Nexcom with the Project Manager permission set

flows.name: Grant and enforce Project Manager commitment writes
steps: Update every Project Manager template without changing other module rules
Enforce commitment read and write levels in subcontract and purchase-order RLS
Read back the live templates, policies, and Kebba principal decision
flows.expectedOutcome: Project Managers can read, create, edit, and delete commitments while users without Commitments write remain denied

flows.name: Fail unauthorized and broken lookups closed
steps: Exercise a person with no directory, role, or company access
Confirm both conditions return explicit denial rather than empty permissions
flows.expectedOutcome: Missing access returns 403 and an access lookup failure returns a specific server error

claims.description: Project role and company template access reach the project shell and portfolio through the effective Project Manager template
Both Project Manager templates and the live Kebba principal grant Commitments write at the database boundary
Missing access and access-query failures remain explicit denials
